_comment: Polaris-only wind-tunnel validation (build e0f63f86+: $nav wind + $nav seam, defaults ON; outroute OFF). SetLevel=4 in soak-dedicated.cfg starts directly on Polaris; TimeLimit=30 makes it one uninterrupted round. Judge: red+blue conversion (flags adjacent to tunnel rooms both sides), seam-guard firings, no 'via suspended arrivals without crossing' at room 99, navdump wind_mag values vs BOT_WIND_TUNNEL_MIN=10.
